links.comparator_used: Non-generative readout with default (uncalibrated) cutpoints, with no local labels
links.outcome: Quadratic-weighted kappa for four-class ASA-PS against recorded ASA class, local temporal validation set
links.effect: Uncalibrated readout kappa 0.460; with cutpoints fitted on 100 local labels kappa 0.526 and on 1,000 local labels kappa 0.534
links.tradeoff: Requires a few local labels per site (100 to 1,000); the calibrated readout still did not match LoRA's exact agreement (0.666 versus 0.746).
links.quote: Cutpoints fitted on 100 and 1,000 local labels gave κ = 0.526 and 0.534
